name: Zookeeper Gwen

intro.text: Dudley Zoo is in the castle grounds. We have the lot: penguins, okapis, a very loud peacock. It's the only zoo I know with a castle.

win: That's bad for morale. Not for the peacock, though.
after: Some of the zoo buildings were designed by the same architect who did London Zoo's penguin pool. They look like very modern concrete bunkers, in the best way.
